verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos with 'Cable Routing', 'Equipment Location', 'Meter Box' and similar captions on pages 4+.
verdicts.photo_observation: Page 12: DC route from the array across the roof. Page 13: DC enters the headroom room to the inverter, with the battery and UPS point beside it. Page 14: AC (purple) from the solar meter to the main meter. Pages 15-17: earthing route down the shaft to the earth point, switching from 16 sq. mm Al to the customer's 6 sq. mm Cu. Gaps: no DCDB or ACDB is marked, the AC run from the headroom down to the ground-floor meter room is not traced, and conduit/clipping on exposed roof runs is not shown.
verdicts.rationale: The route is mostly documented, but the DCDB/ACDB positions and the inverter-to-meter-room AC segment are missing, and the earthing changes size mid-run (explained in the caption).
